context: A small Saturday class at Asuka's language school. Ren has come as a guest student to help test a new lesson plan. The other students are away — just the two of them.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.en: Ren, thank you so much for coming today.
lines.jp: レン、今日、本当に来てくれてありがとう。

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.en: No, I was looking forward to it. Happy to help however I can.
lines.jp: いえ、楽しみで。お役に立てれば。

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.en: I wanted to try out some new material with you, if that's all right.
lines.jp: 新しい教材、少し試してみたいの。

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.en: Of course. Does it look pretty difficult?
lines.jp: はい、もちろん。…難しそう？

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.en: No, it's fine, really. Let's work through it together.
lines.jp: ふふっ、大丈夫、本当に。…一緒に考えよう。

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.en: I have plenty of time — don't worry about that.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.en: All right then — let's start with the first one.
lines.jp: じゃ、最初の問題から、いこう。
